answer: Require every agent to earn reputation through attested useful work before it can transact: a brand-new identity starts on a narrow ledge with zero weight, and only verified deliveries move it forward. An onyx token, minted per completed job and impossible to mint for free, acts as the work receipt. A sybil attacker faces a nebula of identical-looking accounts that all still have to do real, paid-for work for weeks before gaining any influence — faking thousands of identities costs thousands of jobs' worth of effort, while honest agents earn weight naturally.
